entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait, so you cook it yourself...[n]on this griddle... with a spatula!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Isn't this a restaurant? Why is[n]the customer making their meal!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm... Do you know how[n]to make monjayaki?
I don't.
Leave it to me.
Anything's worth a try.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I-I see... Well, I suppose[n]we'll just have to try it out.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, they have instructions here.[n]Let's see... Mix, cook, serve...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I need more details than that!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, that sounds good.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I would be sad if I tried to do it[n]and ended up ruining our food...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Instead, I'd like to take this[n]opportunity to learn how to[n]make it. Will you teach me?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: True... There has to be a[n]first time for everything.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Whether or not you have the[n]willpower to actually go forth[n]and try it is the difference.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Okay... I'm going to cook[n]the perfect monjayaki!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um, excuse me! I'd like to[n]order the most traditional[n]monja on your menu.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And let's see... I'd also like[n]one of each of the most popular[n]items, from number one down...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh! And a mentai cheese[n]as well, please.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I think I'm starting to learn!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Monjayaki is so interesting![n]I never expected it to be[n]this much fun...!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Could it be that this is an[n]alternate form of entertainment?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Say, you can still eat more,[n]right? Boys are supposed to be[n]able to eat a lot, after all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Please let me try once[n]more! I promise not to[n]mess it up this time!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I ate far too much... Hm, it[n]seems monja is no ordinary food.
